_comment: Arm spec for analysis/tables. All paths are placeholders, relative to this file. Arm names are the paper's; see README.md for the schema.

ablations._comment: Medical 4B ablations (ablations.py). role: table = cuts the common item sets; base = the untrained row (also cuts); appendix = scored on the common sets, never cuts; side = single-seed control, also paired with side_reference.

main_results._comment: Cross-domain table (main_results.py). One cell per (size, arm, seed); list values are repeated evaluations of one checkpoint. Writing suites point at the writing-domain policy, Arena at the dialogue-domain policy, MedQA/HealthBench at the medical policy, GPQA/ResearchQA at the science policy; SFT is one model for all four.

paired_consensus._comment: Comparisons kept out of the ablation item set (paired_consensus.py --which NAME).

crosscheck._comment: Third-family ranking check (crosscheck_rank.py), seed-42 cells. pro = evaluation-judge grades, alt = third-family grades of the same responses.
